_about: Cards for VOOL skills (instructions VOOL follows).

skill.list.use_when: The person wants to know which skills VOOL has or has turned on.
examples: what skills do you have
list my skills
which skills are installed
show the skills I made
qué habilidades tienes instaladas
quelles compétences as-tu
not_for: what skills should I put on my cv
how do I learn new skills

skill.create.use_when: The person wants VOOL to learn a new skill: a saved set of instructions for a kind of task.
examples: make a skill for writing my weekly report
create a new skill that formats recipes my way
teach yourself a skill for replying to customer emails
save this as a skill
crea una habilidad para resumir reuniones
not_for: what skills do I need to be a nurse

skill.install.use_when: The person wants a skill they made or added turned on.
examples: turn on the recipe skill
install the skill I just made
activate my report skill
not_for: install spotify

skill.remove.use_when: The person wants a skill they made turned off.
examples: turn off the recipe skill
remove my report skill
disable the skill I made yesterday
not_for: remove the background from this photo
